newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM assigns A1 rating to Public Packages bonds.
newsitem.headline: RAM assigns A1 rating to Public Packages bonds.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Friday it had assigned a long-term rating of A1 to Public Packages Holdings Bhd's proposed 50 million ringgit guaranteed bonds issue.
In a statement, RAM said the rating indicates adequate safety of timely repayment of interest and principal on the facility.

"The rating assigned was based upon the credit enhancement in the form of unconditional and irrevocable guarantees provided by Malaysian Industrial Development Bhd, Malaysian International Merchant Bank Bhd and Arab Malaysian Finance Bhd, which have been accorded long term ratings of AA3, A1 and A1 respectively by RAM," it said.
Public Packages is an investment holding company with subsidiaries involved in the manufacture of corrugated cartons, gifts and display boxes, packaging materials and property development.
